I can't rule out down or right yet, so I'll make an educated guess: down.
Going right leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes down.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going to number 5 leaves no safe move afterwards; going right, every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves; going down, the next 3 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (4,5).
